info.name: The Curse of the Black Witch

descriptions.notStarted: ...Wait, is this Ereve? But Ereve's usually not like this. And why are the Chief Knights standing like that? No one's answering! Only #p1101001# seemed to be barely awake. I better talk to #b#p1101001##k.
descriptions.inProgress: #p1101001# told me the lady in front is actually #r#p1104002# the #o9001010##k and that she has put a curse on everyone in Ereve. He mentioned that most of them on the island should be able to weather it, but the Empress might be in grave danger... I better defeat #o9001010# and break the curse now! \n\n#o9001010##r #a204071##k
descriptions.completed: The cunning #o9001010#, after realizing that Ereve, which is protected by #p1101001#, may be hard to enter, used #p1103000# to throw in cursed items, then cursed the whole island through that! Fortunately, after defeating #o9001010#, the curse seems to have been lifted.
